name: Corbenic

attributes.attribute: was the site of the trick

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Corbenic is a place in Arthurian legend. The magician Brisen used it to test Lancelot. She made Lancelot drunk and told him the queen waited in a secret chamber. He entered and met a beautiful woman instead. Brisen meant the trick as a kindness to her friend, who loved Lancelot. The night passed as an illusion. Lancelot learned of the ruse when he woke.

okr.objective: Corbenic is the place where Brisen tricked Lancelot.
key_results: Brisen made Lancelot drunk at Corbenic.
A beautiful woman waited in a secret chamber.
Lancelot spent a blissful night there.
He learned of the trick when he woke.
